title: iOS 1.14 — Observed tab highlight and route ribbon
body:
- Observed tab, reorganised: on flight day a one-line highlight sums up what's changed since your briefing, with any alerts right under it and everything else under Details. Rate the highlight with a thumbs up or down.
- Route ribbon: a picture of your route with radar rain, cells, SIGMETs and airports along it. Tap any mark for a card with its details, the raw METAR/TAF, and a Show on map button.
- En-route cell alerts: radar cells developing near your track now raise an alert, and each cell shows how close it would come to you if it keeps its current speed and heading.
- Clearer live SIGMETs: you're warned about SIGMETs issued but not yet valid, reissues no longer alert twice, and a failed SIGMET check no longer reads as "none listed".
- Flight descriptions: give a flight a description and find it again from the flight list search, which now matches trip names too.
- Trips are titled with your own trip name.
- Sharper weather digests, written by a newer model, with worst cases from a single model labelled as a minority view.
